description: This file is part of the PyTorch project, specifically related to quantization using FX graph mode. It provides utilities for preparing models for quantization, inserting observers, propagating dtype information, and handling custom configurations. The file includes functions to modify FX graphs, insert modules, check backend support for quantization patterns, and manage metadata related to quantization targets.
